ledger.note: 1990-11-15: the People's Republic of Bulgaria becomes the Republic of Bulgaria. 'On 15 November the People's Republic of Bulgaria was officially renamed to the Republic of Bulgaria'; Zhivkov was deposed on 10 November 1989 and 'On 12 July 1991 with the new Constitution' the People's Republic's symbols were dissolved.

certainty.note: The frontiers are inherited ones: Greece and Turkey to the south, Serbia and North Macedonia to the west, the Danube to Romania; the Bulgaria page gives no border change or treaty after 1990.

notes: Wikidata Q121932 is shared with people-s-republic-of-bulgaria (Cliopatria 1948..1990, another eu-22 part). Same country under two regimes, kept as two dossiers (Cliopatria rows, as with Albania and Romania), colour family balkans so one colour is possible. The start follows the page (15 November 1990) rather than the Cliopatria row (1991). The pages read are silent on any border treaty with North Macedonia, Serbia or Romania after 1990; page budget 2 of 2 used.
